issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: /dev/null
products.tagline: a social network for devs
products.summaryZh: 一个面向开发者的社交网络
products.descriptionZh: /dev/null 最初源自 JetBrains 办公室的一场直播。2026 年 10 月 15 日，Nuno Maduro、Brent Roose、Matthieu Napoli 和 Pauline Vos 在公开环境下，用 48 小时从零构建了一个面向 Web 开发者的社交网络。使用 GitHub 登录，分享代码片段，点赞、回复等等！数百人提交了 PR。Laravel 的 Taylor Otwell 在直播中途到访（“Laravel forever”），Vercel 的 Guillermo Rauch 称其“做得非常出色”。感谢你们的观看、分享和吐槽。
products.description: /dev/null started as a live stream from the JetBrains office. On Oct 15, 2026, Nuno Maduro, Brent Roose, Matthieu Napoli, and Pauline Vos built a social network for web developers from scratch in 48 hours, in the open. Sign in with GitHub, share code snippets, like, reply, etc, etc! Hundreds of you sent PRs. Laravel’s Taylor Otwell stopped by mid-stream (“Laravel forever”), and Vercel’s Guillermo Rauch called it “really well done.” Thank you for watching, sharing, and roasting us.

products.name: Composio Instant
products.tagline: The easiest way for AI agents to pay for their own tools
products.summaryZh: AI代理为自己的工具付费的最简便方式
products.descriptionZh: 赋予你的智能体超能力。无需订阅，无需注册。借助 Composio Instant，你的智能体可以搜索网络、查找商务联系人、制作配音、将音频转为文本，以及更多功能。免费试用：composio.dev/instant
products.description: Give your agent superpowers. No subscriptions, no signups. With Composio Instant, your agent can search the web, find business contacts, create voiceovers, turn audio into text, and so much more. Try it free: composio.dev/instant

products.name: Hoistbay
products.tagline: Open-source desktop app for Amazon S3 and CloudFront
products.summaryZh: 用于 Amazon S3 和 CloudFront 的开源桌面应用
products.descriptionZh: Hoistbay 是一款免费的 macOS 和 Windows 桌面应用，可免除 S3 和 CloudFront 中重复性的工作。只需设置一次标头规则（按文件模式设置 Cache-Control、Content-Type、Content-Encoding），这些规则便会在每次上传时自动应用。可下载整个文件夹，一键清除 CloudFront 缓存，并即时切换 AWS 账户。密钥保存在操作系统钥匙串中，无后端，无遥测。MIT 许可。
products.description: Hoistbay is a free desktop app for macOS and Windows that takes the repetitive work out of S3 and CloudFront. Set header rules once (Cache-Control, Content-Type, Content-Encoding by file pattern) and they apply on every upload. Download whole folders, clear CloudFront cache in one click, and switch AWS accounts instantly. Keys stay in your OS keychain, no backend, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

products.name: Harness²
products.tagline: Harness the agent. Then harness its self-improvement.
products.summaryZh: 驾驭智能体，进而驾驭其自我改进。
products.descriptionZh: Google Research 的 Harness² 是一个即插即用的递归智能体利用框架，让 LLM 智能体能够针对开放世界任务自动演化其执行框架（提示、工具、记忆），无需真实标注验证器。双重递归：任务级的提议-探测-组合精炼 + 框架级的可复用经验积累。在 WorkBuddy-Bench 等专业基准上最高提升 11.5 分。
products.description: Harness² from Google Research is a plug-and-play recursive agent harnessing framework that lets LLM agents automatically evolve their execution harnesses (prompts, tools, memory) for open-world tasks—without ground-truth verifiers. Dual recursion: task-level Propose-Probe-Compose refinement + harnessing-level accumulation of reusable experience. Up to +11.5 points on professional benchmarks like WorkBuddy-Bench.

products.name: Exa 3.0
products.tagline: Smarter search that gives AI agent richer data at lower cost
products.summaryZh: 更智能的搜索，以更低成本为AI代理提供更丰富的数据
products.descriptionZh: Exa 3.0 是 Exa 面向 AI 智能体的搜索 API 在搜索质量上最大的一次更新。它新增了更大的嵌入模型、数十亿份新文档（包括 12.7 亿条电商商品信息和 2.11 亿多家本地商户），以及 Dynamic Highlights，后者使用的 token 比整页文本少 95%。新的 Exa Lite 档位每 1,000 次请求收费 4 美元，Exa Auto 收费 7 美元。现已通过 API 提供。
products.description: Exa 3.0 is the biggest search quality update to Exa’s search API for AI agents. It adds a larger embedding model, billions of new documents including 1.27B ecommerce listings and 211M+ local businesses, and Dynamic Highlights, which use 95% fewer tokens than full page text. A new Exa Lite tier costs $4 per 1,000 requests, and Exa Auto costs $7. Available now through the API.

products.name: Mintlify Autopilot
products.tagline: An always-on agent that keeps your docs up to date
products.summaryZh: 一个始终在线的代理，让你的文档保持最新
products.descriptionZh: Autopilot 是 Mintlify 推出的常驻文档代理。它会持续关注你的代码以及 Slack 等工具，在发生变化时起草文档更新，并创建拉取请求供团队审核。它会从你合并或关闭的每个 PR 中学习你的风格。
products.description: Autopilot is an always-on docs agent from Mintlify. It watches your code and tools like Slack, drafts doc updates when something changes, and opens a pull request for your team to review. It learns your style from every PR you merge or close.

products.name: Asimov 1
products.tagline: The most customizable humanoid robot you can buy
products.summaryZh: 你能买到的最可定制的人形机器人
products.descriptionZh: Asimov 1 是一款可以让你在其基础上建立公司的人形机器人。训练它，并根据你所构建的任何事物来塑造它。已被 20 多个国家的创始人、研究人员和开发者购买。
products.description: Asimov 1 is a humanoid robot you can build a company on. Train it and shape it for whatever you're building. Bought by founders, researchers and developers in 20+ countries.

products.name: RunInfra
products.tagline: Open models, built for agents.
products.summaryZh: 开放模型，为智能体而生。
products.descriptionZh: RunInfra 编程方案以每月固定价格，为你的编程智能体提供快速开放模型，起价 10 美元。可在 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cline、Droid 或 Grok Build 中使用 GLM 5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Qwen3.8 27B 等模型。设置只需一条提示词：粘贴到智能体中，批准登录，即可完成。会话感知路由的缓存命中率最高可达 99.5%，让你的方案更耐用。零数据保留，不使用提示词训练，SOC 2 Type II。
products.description: RunInfra Coding Plans give your coding agent fast open models for a flat monthly price, starting at $10. Use GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B and more inside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, Droid or Grok Build. Setup takes one prompt: paste it into your agent, approve sign-in, done. Session-aware routing hits cache up to 99.5% of the time, so your plan goes further. Zero data retention, no training on prompts, SOC 2 Type II.

products.name: Kling 4.0
products.tagline: Fast and affordable AI video for high-frequency creators
products.summaryZh: 为高频创作者提供快速且实惠的AI视频
products.descriptionZh: Kling 4.0 是一款 AI 视频模型，面向需要掌控力而非碰运气的创作者、营销人员和工作室。与提示词碰运气的生成器不同，你先锁定故事：最多 10 个关键帧、15 个参考素材和 8,000 token 提示词，一次生成 30 秒片段。内置立体声音频和 10 多种语言的唇形同步。创意复现可在现有视频中替换产品或角色。Kling 4.0 Flash 负责快速、低成本的草稿，MCP + CLI 访问可将其接入智能体工作流。
products.description: Kling 4.0 is an AI video model for creators, marketers and studios who need control, not lucky rerolls. Unlike prompt-and-pray generators, you lock the story first: up to 10 keyframes, 15 reference assets and 8,000-token prompts drive 30-second clips in a single pass. Stereo audio and lip sync in 10+ languages are built in. Creative Recreation swaps products or characters in existing videos. Kling 4.0 Flash handles fast, cheaper drafts, and MCP + CLI access plugs it into agent workflows.

products.name: Inflight
products.tagline: The missing feedback layer for prototypes
products.summaryZh: 原型缺失的反馈层
products.descriptionZh: 分享预览链接或 HTML 原型。评审者可将评论固定到真实元素上，或直接在运行中的应用内录制视频。Inflight 会将这些反馈转化为后续步骤，你的编码代理（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）可通过 MCP 拉取。
products.description: Share a preview link or HTML prototype. Reviewers pin comments to real elements, or record video, right on the running app. Inflight turns that feedback into next steps your coding agent (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) pulls in over MCP.

products.name: ToDo.is
products.tagline: Write a to-do and your AI agent gets it done
products.summaryZh: 写下待办事项，你的AI代理就能将其完成。
products.descriptionZh: Todo.is 是一个始终在线的 AI 智能体，你只需把待办事项交给它。写下“找一趟飞往里斯本的更便宜航班”或“把这个 PDF 转成 Word”，它就会去做：带来源地调研、生成文件和图片、使用网站，并通过网页、Android、WhatsApp 或 Telegram 汇报结果。它在自己的沙盒中全天候运行，记得你，按计划提供每日简报和价格提醒，能在你自己的 Chrome 中工作，并在付款、发送或删除任何内容前先征求你的同意。只需 1 美元即可试用。
products.description: Todo.is is an always-on AI agent you give to-dos to. Write "find a cheaper flight to Lisbon" or "turn this PDF into Word" and it does the work: researches with sources, makes files and images, uses websites, and reports back on the web, Android, WhatsApp or Telegram. It runs 24/7 in its own sandbox, remembers you, does daily briefings and price alerts on a schedule, can work in your own Chrome, and asks before it pays, sends or deletes anything. Try it for $1.

products.name: ESP-Mosaico
products.tagline: A modular development board built for agents
products.summaryZh: 为智能体打造的模块化开发板
products.descriptionZh: ESP-Mosaico 专为编程智能体打造，是一款基于 ESP32-S31 的模块化开发板。它将 AI 智能体从软件世界带入物理世界，使其能够创建、部署、测试并迭代真实硬件。可扩展模块与多单元拼接为 AI 智能体提供了更多创造方式，而 Chat Coding 和 Vibe Coding 则让你以直观的方式将想法转化为可工作的物理设备。
products.description: Built for Coding Agents, ESP-Mosaico is a modular development board powered by ESP32-S31. It takes AI agents beyond software and into the physical world, enabling them to create, deploy, test, and iterate on real hardware. Expandable modules and multi-unit tiling give AI agents more ways to create, while Chat Coding and Vibe Coding give you intuitive ways to turn ideas into working physical devices.

products.name: Tiny Little Office
products.tagline: A tiny office suite where the link is the document
products.summaryZh: 链接即文档的微型办公套件
products.descriptionZh: 十款小巧应用（文本、电子表格、幻灯片、大纲、计算器、绘图、图表、动画、日历、行程），整个文档都存在于其 URL 中。无需账户，无需服务器，除非你将其保存在自己的设备上，否则不会保存任何内容。分享链接：那就是文件。
products.description: Ten tiny apps (text, spreadsheet, slides, outliner, calculator, drawing, diagrams, animation, calendar, trips) where the whole document lives in its URL. No accounts, no server, nothing saved unless you keep it on your device. Share the link: that's the file.

products.name: bonds
products.tagline: Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers
products.summaryZh: 每个好友聊天群都会拥有一位拥有超能力的AI朋友
products.descriptionZh: bonds是面向下一代的消息应用。每个好友聊天里都会有一个拥有超能力的AI朋友。它不是助手：它懂你们的内部笑话，让乐趣延续，帮你们一起成事。有点疯💀 “一周不刷TikTok？”它会在聊天里创建一个带连续打卡的挑战应用。无需下载。还有游戏、视频、贴纸。它记得你们每个人在意的事，察觉有人情绪低落，你冷落它它还会闹脾气。你关心它，它也关心你。
products.description: bonds is the messaging app for the next generation. Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers. Not an assistant: it gets your inside jokes, keeps the fun going, helps you pull things off together. A little unhinged 💀 "A week without TikTok?" It creates a challenge app with streaks, inside the chat. No downloads. Games, videos, stickers, too. It remembers what matters to each of you, notices when someone's struggling, gets grumpy if you ghost it. You care for it, it cares for you.

products.name: Jotform App Builder for ChatGPT & Claude
products.tagline: Build and edit no-code apps inside ChatGPT & Claude
products.summaryZh: 在ChatGPT和Claude中构建和编辑无代码应用
products.descriptionZh: 告诉ChatGPT或Claude你需要什么样的应用，然后用Jotform App Builder构建它。创建一个客户门户、员工中心、活动应用或产品目录，将你的表单、文档和链接整合在一起。请求更改内容、布局或品牌，然后与客户或团队分享应用。基于现有的Jotform表单构建，用于收集回复、接受付款和收集已签署的文档。无需编码。
products.description: Tell ChatGPT or Claude what kind of app you need, and build it with Jotform App Builder. Create a customer portal, employee hub, event app, or product catalog that brings your forms, documents, and links together. Ask for changes to the content, layout, or branding, then share the app with customers or your team. Build on your existing Jotform forms for collecting responses, accepting payments, and gathering signed documents. No coding required.

products.name: xtty
products.tagline: A terminal that makes everyday work easier.
products.summaryZh: 让日常工作更轻松的终端。
products.descriptionZh: 把时间花在工作上，而不是终端上。xtty 是原生 macOS 终端，适用于日常 SSH 和编码代理工作。批量连接已保存的主机，使用已配置的密码自动填充，通过 sz/rz 传输文件，并使用标签页和分屏窗格。复制标签页会在同一远程目录中打开独立的 SSH 连接。包含广播输入和编码代理状态。支持 Apple Silicon 和 Intel。免费版；可选一次性购买 Pro。
products.description: Spend your time on the work, not the terminal. xtty is a native macOS terminal for everyday SSH and coding-agent work. Batch-connect to saved hosts, use configured password autofill, transfer files with sz/rz, and work with tabs and split panes. Duplicate Tab opens an independent SSH connection in the same remote directory. Includes broadcast input and coding-agent status. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free edition; optional one-time Pro purchase.

products.name: Portlivo
products.tagline: Every local dev server on your Mac, in the menu bar
products.summaryZh: Mac 上的每个本地开发服务器，尽在菜单栏中
products.descriptionZh: Portlivo 显示 Mac 上运行的每个开发服务器和端口：来自哪个项目、命令、运行时长以及是否响应。一键打开、重启、终止、跟踪日志或分享任意一个。原生应用，无需账户，一次性付费。
products.description: Portlivo shows every dev server and port running on your Mac: which project it's from, the command, uptime and whether it's answering. Open, restart, kill, tail logs or share any of them in one click. Native, no account, one-time price.

products.name: snyvi
products.tagline: All your passion projects, in one calm place
products.summaryZh: 你所有的热情项目，都在一个宁静的地方
products.descriptionZh: snyvi 是一款免费、开源的桌面应用，面向同时用编码智能体推进多个个人项目的人。每个项目都有自己的工作台：项目文件夹、最多四个并排运行的智能体（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 或任意 shell），以及独立的笔记。智能体写下的每份计划或评审都会以整洁的页面形式落到该工作台上，并带有版本记录。首页会显示每个项目上次停在哪里。仅本地运行，无需账号，MIT 许可。招募 Mac 测试者：Mac 版本已签名并完成公证，但我们没有 Mac。试用后请告诉我们。
products.description: snyvi is a free, open-source desktop app for people building several passion projects at once with coding agents. Each project gets a desk: its folder, up to four agents side by side (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, any shell), and its own notes. Every plan or review an agent writes lands on that desk as a clean page, versioned. Home shows where each project was left. Local only, no account, MIT. Mac tester needed: the Mac build is signed and notarized, but we don't own a Mac. Try it and tell us.

products.name: KVWang
products.tagline: Browser phone and follow-up notes for US customer calls
products.summaryZh: 美国客户电话的浏览器电话和跟进记录
products.descriptionZh: 在浏览器中手动呼叫美国客户，并将联系人、通话记录和后续步骤备注集中管理。可试用模拟演示，不会产生真实通话。真实呼叫需单独审批并分配号码。由 Tapilot LLC 运营。每月 $15，包含 200 分钟美国普通计费通话；额外分钟按 $0.02 计费。高成本及特殊目的地被屏蔽。并非自主 AI 呼叫代理。
products.description: Manually call US customers from your browser and keep contacts, call history and next-step notes together. Try a simulated demo with no real calls. Real calling requires individual approval and number assignment. Operated by Tapilot LLC. $15/month includes 200 ordinary US billed minutes; extra minutes cost $0.02. High-cost and special destinations are blocked. Not an autonomous AI calling agent.

products.name: reception
products.tagline: Native iOS support chat for less churn
products.summaryZh: 原生iOS支持聊天，减少用户流失
products.descriptionZh: 你的 iOS 应用缺少的原生应用内客服聊天。💰 赚更多钱：在聊天中发送优惠和付费墙 ⭐ 从满意的用户那里获得更多 App Store 评价 🔧 在用户流失前实时解决问题 🤖 AI 根据你的文档作答，不确定时转交给你 📥 整个团队共用一个收件箱 ⚡ 一次提示设置：粘贴到你的编码代理中，即可完成 完全原生。支持 Swift、React Native 和 Expo。
products.description: The native in-app support chat your iOS app is missing. 💰 Make more money: send offers and paywalls in the chat ⭐ Get more App Store reviews from happy users 🔧 Fix problems in real time before users churn 🤖 AI answers from your docs, hands off to you when unsure 📥 One inbox for your whole team ⚡ One prompt setup: paste it into your coding agent, done Fully native. Works with Swift, React Native and Expo.
